                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दिल्याप्रमाणे

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          मुद्दल = 2600 रु.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          व्याज दर = m%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          वेळ = 4 वर्षे

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          साधा व्याज = 520 रु.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          सुत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          सरळ व्याज = PRT / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          येथे P हे मुद्दल आहेत, R हे व्याज दर आहे आणि T वर्षांमध्ये कालावधी आहे

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          सरळ व्याज = (2600 × m × 4)/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          520 = (2600 × m × 4)/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ m = 5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ व्याज दर वार्षिक 5% आहे.

"solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          For n = 7 terms, the Median is the 4th term, which is x.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Sum of remaining terms = 4 + 6 + 10 + 20 + 24 + 32 = 96.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          If Mean = Median = x, then Total Sum = 7 × x.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          96 + x = 7x ⇒ 6x = 96 ⇒ x = 16.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 16.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given: Numbers in ascending order are 4, 6, 10, x, 20, 24, 32. Total terms (n) = 7.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Median (for odd n) = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th term

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Median = ((7 + 1) ÷ 2)th term = 4th term

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Median = x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Mean = (4 + 6 + 10 + x + 20 + 24 + 32) ÷ 7

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Mean = (96 + x) ÷ 7

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ According to the question, Mean = Median

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (96 + x) ÷ 7 = x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 96 + x = 7x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 6x = 96

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x = 96 ÷ 6

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x = 16

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 16.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Median of a Data Set

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          For a set of n observations arranged in order, if n is even, the median is the average of (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Empirical Relationship

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The relationship between the three measures of central tendency is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Property of Mean

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The sum of deviations of all observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          n = 7 पदों के लिए, माध्यिका (Median) चौथा पद है, जो x है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          शेष पदों का योग = 4 + 6 + 10 + 20 + 24 + 32 = 96.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          यदि माध्य (Mean) = माध्यिका (Median) = x है, तो कुल योग = 7 × x.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          96 + x = 7x ⇒ 6x = 96 ⇒ x = 16.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 16 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है: आरोही क्रम में संख्याएँ 4, 6, 10, x, 20, 24, 32 हैं। कुल पद (n) = 7.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          माध्य (Mean) = (सभी प्रेक्षणों का योग) ÷ (प्रेक्षणों की कुल संख्या)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          माध्यिका (Median) (विषम n के लिए) = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)वां पद

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ माध्यिका = ((7 + 1) ÷ 2)वां पद = 4वां पद

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ माध्यिका = x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ माध्य = (4 + 6 + 10 + x + 20 + 24 + 32) ÷ 7

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ माध्य = (96 + x) ÷ 7

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ प्रश्न के अनुसार, माध्य = माध्यिका

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (96 + x) ÷ 7 = x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 96 + x = 7x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 6x = 96

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x = 96 ÷ 6

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x = 16

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 16 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          डेटा सेट की माध्यिका

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          क्रम में व्यवस्थित n प्रेक्षणों के एक समूह के लिए, यदि n सम है, तो माध्यिका (n/2)वें और (n/2 + 1)वें पदों का औसत होती है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          अनुभवजन्य संबंध (Empirical Relationship)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          केंद्रीय प्रवृत्ति के तीन मापों के बीच संबंध इस प्रकार दिया गया है: बहुलक (Mode) = 3 × माध्यिका (Median) − 2 × माध्य (Mean).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          माध्य का गुण

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          अपने समांतर माध्य से सभी प्रेक्षणों के विचलनों (deviations) का योग हमेशा शून्य होता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n125:Tc9c,\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Ratio of Income A : Income B = 75 : 100 = 3 : 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Ratio of Income B : Income C = 140 : 100 = 7 : 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Combined Ratio A : C = (3 × 7) : (4 × 5) = 21 : 20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Percentage Increase = ((21 − 20) ÷ 20) × 100 = 5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 5%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Income of ఇవ్వబడినవి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          4, 6, 10, x, 20, 24, 32 ఆరోహణ క్రమంలో ఉన్నాయి

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          సగటు మరియు మధ్యమం సమానం.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          కాన్సెప్ట్:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          సగటు= \\(\\frac{Sum of observations}{No. of Observations}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          లెక్కింపు:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          4, 6, 10, x, 20, 24, 32 యొక్క మధ్యమం x.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          సగటు= \\(\\frac{(4 + 6 + 10 + x + 20 + 24 + 32)}{7}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఇప్పుడు, ప్రశ్న ప్రకారం,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          సగటు= మధ్యమం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\Rightarrow\\) \\(\\frac{(4 + 6 + 10 + x + 20 + 24 + 32)}{7}\\) = x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\Rightarrow\\) (96 + x) = 7x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\Rightarrow\\) x = \\(\\frac{96}{6}\\) = 16

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          కాబట్టి, x విలువ 16.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Calculations : 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          4, 6, 10, x, 20, 24, 32 ର ମଧ୍ୟମା x ଅଟେ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Mean = \\(\\frac{(4 + 6 + 10 + x + 20 + 24 + 32)}{7}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ, ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ମାଧ୍ୟମ = ମଧ୍ୟମା 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\Rightarrow\\) \\(\\frac{(4 + 6 + 10 + x + 20 + 24 + 32)}{7}\\)= x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\Rightarrow\\) (96 + x) = 7x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\Rightarrow\\) x = \\(\\frac{96}{6}\\) = 16

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ଅତଏବ, x ର ମୂଲ୍ୟ 16 ଅଟେ।
