"Rs.3,000"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Rs.4,500"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Single discount = 45%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Equivalent successive discount = 30 + 20 − (30 × 20) ÷ 100 = 50 − 6 = 44%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Difference in discount rates = 45% − 44% = 1%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given, 1% of Marked Price (MP) = Rs. 84.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, 100% (MP) = 84 × 100 = Rs. 8,400.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is Rs. 8,400.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given: First discount = 45%; Successive discounts = 30% and 20%; Difference in SP = Rs. 84.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Formulas: SP = MP × (100 − D%)/100 | Net discount for a and b = a + b − ab/100.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Let Marked Price be M.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ SP1 = M × (100 − 45)/100 = 0.55M.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Equivalent Discount of 30% and 20% = 30 + 20 − (30 × 20)/100 = 44%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ SP2 = M × (100 − 44)/100 = 0.56M.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Difference = SP2 − SP1 = 0.56M − 0.55M = 0.01M.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 0.01M = 84 ⇒ M = 84 ÷ 0.01 = 8,400.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is Rs. 8,400.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Successive Discounts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          When two or more discounts are applied one after another, they are called successive discounts. The net discount is always less than the sum of individual rates.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Marked Price & Selling Price

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Marked Price (MP) is the price printed on the label. Selling Price (SP) is the actual price after deducting the discount from the MP. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          एकल छूट = 45%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          समतुल्य क्रमिक छूट = 30 + 20 − (30 × 20) ÷ 100 = 50 − 6 = 44%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          छूट दरों में अंतर = 45% − 44% = 1%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है, अंकित मूल्य (MP) का 1% = Rs. 84.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          इसलिए, 100% (MP) = 84 × 100 = Rs. 8,400.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर Rs. 8,400 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है: पहली छूट = 45%; क्रमिक छूट = 30% और 20%; विक्रय मूल्य (SP) में अंतर = Rs. 84.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          सूत्र: SP = MP × (100 − D%)/100 | a और b के लिए कुल छूट = a + b − ab/100.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ माना अंकित मूल्य M है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ SP1 = M × (100 − 45)/100 = 0.55M.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 30% और 20% की समतुल्य छूट = 30 + 20 − (30 × 20)/100 = 44%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ SP2 = M × (100 − 44)/100 = 0.56M.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ अंतर = SP2 − SP1 = 0.56M − 0.55M = 0.01M.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 0.01M = 84 ⇒ M = 84 ÷ 0.01 = 8,400.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर Rs. 8,400 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          क्रमिक छूट (Successive Discounts)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          जब एक के बाद एक दो या दो से अधिक छूट दी जाती हैं, तो उन्हें क्रमिक छूट कहा जाता है। कुल छूट हमेशा व्यक्तिगत दरों के योग से कम होती है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          अंकित मूल्य (Marked Price) और विक्रय मूल्य (Selling Price)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          अंकित मूल्य (MP) लेबल पर छपा मूल्य होता है। विक्रय मूल्य (SP) अंकित मूल्य में से छूट घटाने के बाद का वास्तविक मूल्य होता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਰਿਤਿਕ ਇੱਕ ਮੇਜ਼ ਨੂੰ 37.5% ਲਾਭ 'ਤੇ ਵੇਚਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜੇਕਰ ਉਸਨੇ ਇਸਨੂੰ 12.5% ਘੱਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਖਰੀਦਿਆ ਹੁੰਦਾ, ਅਤੇ ₹330 ਘੱਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਹੁੰਦਾ, ਤਾਂ ਉਸਨੂੰ 10% ਦਾ ਲਾਭ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੁੰਦਾ। ਮੇਜ਼ ਦੀ ਲਾਗਤ ਕੀਮਤ ₹1,000 ਤੋਂ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਘੱਟ ਹੈ?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "22%"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "20%"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "23%"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "21%"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Let initial CP1 = 100 units. Initial SP1 = 137.5 units (at 37.5% profit).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          New CP2 = 100 − 12.5 = 87.5 units. New SP2 = 87.5 × 1.1 = 96.25 units.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Difference in SP = 137.5 − 96.25 = 41.25 units. Given 41.25 units = ₹330.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1 unit = 330 ÷ 41.25 = 8. So, Original CP = 100 × 8 = ₹800.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Percentage less than ₹1,000 = [(1,000 − 800) ÷ 1,000] × 100 = 20%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 20%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nGiven → Initial profit = 37.5%, CP reduction = 12.5%, SP reduction = ₹330, New profit = 10%.\nFormulas: SP = CP × (100 + P%) ÷ 100 | Percentage difference = (Diff ÷ Base) × 100.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n⇒ Let Initial CP be 100x. Then Initial SP = 137.5x.\n⇒ New CP = 100x − 12.5% of 100x = 87.5x.\n⇒ New SP = 87.5x + 10% of 87.5x = 87.5x + 8.75x = 96.25x.\n⇒ Difference in SP = 137.5x − 96.25x = 41.25x.\n⇒ According to question: 41.25x = 330 ⇒ x = 330 ÷ 41.25 = 8.\n⇒ Original CP = 100 × 8 = ₹800.\n⇒ Required Percent = [(1,000 − 800) ÷ 1,000] × 100 = (200 ÷ 1,000) × 100 = 20%.\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 20%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Fractional Conversion

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          37.5% can be written as 3/8. This often simplifies calculations involving Cost Price and Selling Price ratios.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Percentage Comparison

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          To find by what percent A is less than B, use formula: [(B − A) ÷ B] × 100.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n102:Tf88", "hn": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          माना प्रारंभिक CP1 = 100 यूनिट। प्रारंभिक SP1 = 137.5 यूनिट (37.5% लाभ पर)।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          नया CP2 = 100 − 12.5 = 87.5 यूनिट। नया SP2 = 87.5 × 1.1 = 96.25 यूनिट।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          विक्रय मूल्य (SP) में अंतर = 137.5 − 96.25 = 41.25 यूनिट। दिया गया है 41.25 यूनिट = ₹330.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1 यूनिट = 330 ÷ 41.25 = 8. इसलिए, वास्तविक CP = 100 × 8 = ₹800.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ₹1,000 से कम प्रतिशत = [(1,000 − 800) ÷ 1,000] × 100 = 20%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 20% है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nदिया गया है → प्रारंभिक लाभ = 37.5%, CP में कमी = 12.5%, SP में कमी = ₹330, नया लाभ = 10%.\nसूत्र: SP = CP × (100 + P%) ÷ 100 | प्रतिशत अंतर = (अंतर ÷ आधार) × 100.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n⇒ माना प्रारंभिक CP 100x है। तब प्रारंभिक SP = 137.5x.\n⇒ नया CP = 100x − 100x का 12.5% = 87.5x.\n⇒ नया SP = 87.5x + 87.5x का 10% = 87.5x + 8.75x = 96.25x.\n⇒ SP में अंतर = 137.5x − 96.25x = 41.25x.\n⇒ प्रश्न के अनुसार: 41.25x = 330 ⇒ x = 330 ÷ 41.25 = 8.\n⇒ वास्तविक CP = 100 × 8 = ₹800.\n⇒ अभीष्ट प्रतिशत = [(1,000 − 800) ÷ 1,000] × 100 = (200 ÷ 1,000) × 100 = 20%.\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 20% है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          भिन्नात्मक रूपांतरण (Fractional Conversion)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          37.5% को 3/8 के रूप में लिखा जा सकता है। यह अक्सर क्रय मूल्य और विक्रय मूल्य के अनुपात से जुड़ी गणनाओं को सरल बनाता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          प्रतिशत तुलना (Percentage Comparison)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          यह ज्ञात करने के लिए कि A, B से कितने प्रतिशत कम है, इस सूत्र का उपयोग करें: [(B − A) ÷ B] × 100.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n103:T751,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఇచ్చినవి :

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          లాభం= 37.5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఖరీదు ధర ఎల్లప్పుడూ 100%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          లాభ% = (sp - cp)/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఇక్కడ CP → ఖరీదు ధర, SP → అమ్మకం ధర

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          గణనలు:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          టేబుల్ యొక్క CP X అని అనుకుందాం.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          లాభం = 37.5% [37.5%] = 3/8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          37.5% లాభంతో టేబుల్ యొక్క అమ్మకం ధర

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x + 3x/8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 11x/8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          12.5% నష్టంతో టేబుల్ యొక్క CP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x - 1x/8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 7x/8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          10% లాభంతో టేబుల్ యొక్క SP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 110/100 x 7x/8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 77x/80

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          అప్పుడు, ప్రశ్న ప్రకారం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          11x/8 - 330 = 77x/8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (11x/8) - (77x/8) = 330
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n⇒ (110x - 77x)/80 = 330

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఖరీదు ధర ఎల్లప్పుడూ 100%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          లాభ% = (sp - cp)/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
